mutants.description: Disable the mixed-sublayer BBL start branch. The BBL row must no longer emit the required marker-plus-M624 protocol and is rejected independently of the Marlin2 control.
Disable the mixed-sublayer BBL end branch. The BBL start markers can no longer be paired with the required per-boundary stop marker and M625 command.

Suppress the dedicated mixed-sublayer end-label flush. This is a separate end-of-block hypothesis; its kill remains native-pending because a later writer flush could still expose the deferred command.
